notes.title: UPDATE 1.0 - The Long Awaited "Solo Reflection" Single Player DLC is LIVE!
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming, but now one of the most unique brick breaker games ever created is live as a DLC to Prison Ball: Full Blown!

In this single player mode, you'll control Andy Simms in a relentless action brick breaker where risk vs reward is always part of the game!

Broken bricks from your reflected ball will release copper, silver, and gold coins that can be collected and saved up until the time is right to deposit them in your own personal bank.  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/e78babee7c157be27ac4b23cad893a1d60787188.jpg 

To get your bank, you'll need to accumulate at least 10 copper (or 1 silver) and press the space bar (or your A button on your controller).  You kneel down and blow a "bank bubble" as seen below and be charged 10% of all your coins.  This takes time and finding the right time where you won't lose a ball is part of the frantic fun!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/0404981f780396bb3153e0eed010d8671ebd1b08.jpg

Once the bank bubble has been blown, it will float around the screen several times before finally choose one of the four corners to land on!  When the bank bursts out of the bubble, you're free to simply go stand on it and wait for the green deposit bar to fill to successfully transfer your collection coins into score points at the top of the screen.  Timing again is crucial here and part of the unique "risk vs reward" gameplay never seen before in a brick breaker game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/e8f980e87877a08d3bbcb34689610b584fa4c22b.jpg

Deposit of all coins to points successful!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/b4cf336db18a9c16a0514e3464601236501abaeb.jpg

There's lots of action and chaos to take on in "Solo Reflection"!

If the ball hits your body instead of your paddle, it will hurt and you'll see your pain meter at the top go up.  The higher your pain level gets, the slower you'll move!  ..Thankfully, some bricks will release pain pills that you can collect to help reduce your pain level and start moving faster again!

To help make the end of levels easier, when less than ten bricks remain, the bricks will slowly begin increasing in size so hitting them is much easier and less frustrating!  We've all played those brick breaker games where hitting the last brick or two seems to take forever and can test your patience!  ..Not in Prison Ball: Solo Reflection!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/ce2369f3382139cc3123a70c460ea805e3fe43ac.jpg

There are already many levels of different brick layouts to progress through with more coming soon!  Steam high scores are live with this launch and the first time Prison Ball: Full Blown has allowed you to compete with your friends and other Steam users!  Every copper coin could make a difference in score totals on the high score list!

Be sure to check out the bundle options to save the most money whether you already own the base Prison Ball: Full Blown game or not...  there's surely a discount offer that will save you money and many bundle options to choose from!

I made Solo Reflection with "fun" as my top priority!  Please let me know what you think in the comments below or in the forums for this game!

Thank you and enjoy!


-  ZaxtorGameS  (Solo indie developer)

notes.title: Prison Ball: Full Blown Base Game Will No Longer Be "FREE"
notes.content:
Prison Ball: Full Blown was made free-to-play way back in January of 2020.  The ultimate reason for this was to get the base game in the hands of many Steam players.  Since that date, more than 10,000 Steam users have taken advantage of getting this game for free, but the sales of DLC hasn't increased and sadly the game hasn't gotten more than a small handful of reviews.

Prison Ball: Full Blown was not developed to be handed out at no cost as it offers a completely unique blend of several popular arcade style games and also allows you to play against a friend or an AI opponent.

A lot of hard work and creativity went into Prison Ball: Full Blown, and I'm sad to see that making my game "free" hasn't benefited the game in any way.  It saddens me as an indie developer that so many people don't mind downloading a game and playing it for nothing, and won't even consider spending a few moments writing a review.  I'd understand people not bothering to write a review for a game they only played a few moments for free, however, the average median play time for Prison Ball: Full Blown is a staggering 3 hrs, and 27 minutes!  That average play time for this game is many times all of my other charged games median play time and it's not even close!  ..People ARE playing this game, that much is obvious.

So, I'm letting people know that Prison Ball's base game will now go back to being charged at the median price point it was between launch ($6.99) and just before it went free-to-play ($2.99).  $4.99 will be the price for this game going forward and a bundle will be made available soon that will include all of the DLC.  More DLC such as the "Solo Reflection" single player challenge mode will be available soon as well.

Thanks for reading, and for understanding.  Being an indie developer is very rewarding, but it can consume a lot of time and hard work and be frustrating sometimes as well.  

I wish you all the best and thanks for playing my game!

-  ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie developer)

- Fixed how long the CPU was stunned with the strobe light on Vast Shadows

- Fixed an issue where Vasts ball that he splits would turn blue a split second after spawning three new Vast balls.  It now should work as intended

- Fixed an issue where the middle ball captured would correctly score points for the side who captured it but would sometimes display the wrong color

- Fixed an issue where the captured ball would not score points or be attainable by either player after losing its ball guard when certain situational conditions occurred.  This has been corrected in this patch

notes.title: UPDATE 0.95 - Andy, Angela, and Dante Get Special Abilities! New DLC too!!
notes.content:
In this update, the default three characters that come with Prison Ball: Full Blown completely free have received all new special abilities!  Let's take a look at each new ability:

Andy Simms gets the "Erection" ability!

Andy can now use his ability button to erect a new green wall directly in front of him when the wall has ten bricks or less.  This can be used with good timing to trap his balls inside to score big points very quickly!

------------

Dante Vaughn gets the "Aggrandize" ability!

As if Dante's huge paddle wasn't big enough already, Dante now gets the ability to make his paddle insanely massive at the push of his ability button!  While it only lasts a few seconds, it can be used to either deflect balls that might otherwise had got by him!

Also note that while his paddle is enlarged with Aggrandize, Dante's paddle will also effectively destroy incoming blow attack bubbles! 

His paddle has a meter in front of it that will fill and flash when the Aggrandize ability is ready.

-----------

Angela Diaz gets the "Auto Blow" ability!

Angela has always enjoyed using her blowing skills in the prison, but now she can truly show what she is best at with the press of her ability button!  When used, her blow attack is automatically controlled to give her the best chance at landing her blow attack for a stun and freeze of her opponent!


Q)  What is the "ability button"?

A) The ability button is the X button on the controller, the Space Bar for local player 1 on the keyboard, and the Right Shift key for local player 2 on a keyboard.


Also note that the "PWN'ong: Duel of Balls" DLC has been officially released as well to offer a completely different game.  All characters you own can be used in this new game mode, but no special abilities can be used here.   In PWN'ong, your goal is again to score more points than your opponent when the timer ends, but there are no bricks here.  

Get balls past your opponent into the goal behind them to score points.  Each time a ball is reflected by a either paddle, that ball's point value increases by one.  The balls will display their current value every time they are reflected by a paddle and will also change color as they increase in value (grey, blue, green, yellow, orange, red and purple)

The blow attacks in PWN'ong work different here  as well.  First you'll use your primary buttons to use a blow attack when your blow meter is full below your character (A button on the controller, Space for keyboard player #1, Right Shift for keyboard player #2)  If you steer your blow bubble into a ball, the ball you hit will be reflected at a very high velocity towards your opponents goal!

PWN'ong: Duel of Balls offers a completely new game with the same characters you already own in the game!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.88 - Massive Update! Balance, Bugs Squashed, More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35273872/56eb549e65c202dbf30a8228839131bb640a8c41.png

I've been working hard to make my Free-To-Play title "Prison Ball: Full Blown" a more enjoyable and better polished game to play!  Here's just a few of the things changed in this huge update to my unique Breakout / Pong combination game:

- The computer A.I. for all characters has been completely overhauled and should present even the best breakout players a run for their money!

- Shadows and polish added to characters Angela Diaz and Dante Vaughn.  They look a little better and their movement looks cleaner now.

- Every brick now glimmers with sparkles of light

- Brick layout has been changed to allow for better gameplay

- Enhancements made to the re-spawning of walls to make it look crisper and cleaner

- An indicator now shows "slowdown" above the head of any character slowed down by getting hit by a poison ball from character Toxik Karess


- Balance change:  Vast Shadows movement speed reduced from 9 to 7
- Balance change: Toxik Karess movement speed increased from 7 to 9
- Balance change: Angela, Dante, and Andy are stronger than DLC characters against the              poison and slow movement of DLC character Toxik Karess
- Balance change: Computer A.I. is now less effective at hitting Vast Shadows ball split ability
- Balance change: Neutral blue balls now do less damage to bricks, breaking them less often
- Balance change: Deborah Fire now handles hitting Vast Shadows split balls better than ever
- Balance change:  Taking over one of Vast's balls with your opposing color and hitting an interior pink brick is not the only way to destroy it and cast the light on Vast as an opponent (Hitting any brick after changing the color of Vast balls to your own destroyed it previously)


BUG FIXES:

- All characters played by the A.I no longer slide up and down without animating as sometimes happened before

- The center ball now correctly scores points for whoever breaks it free

- Respawn highlights are now correctly centered on the wall re-spawns

- Volumes of voices have been balanced better

- Deborah Fire's burning bricks no longer leave fires burning when the brick has been burned up

- Toxik Karess can no longer be affected by slowdown because an opponent changes one of his poison balls to their color.  Only an opponent of another Toxik Karess can make Toxik ill and slow down briefly

- A long standing oddity where balls would never break blue and green bricks from certain sides has been fixed.  Colored balls (white or black) now do damage to bricks and bricks should never take more than three hits before breaking

- Pink interior bricks now properly take longer to burn and score points for Deborah Fire

- An error that would cause black colored balls to sometimes look blurry and have no trails has been fixed

- It should now be impossible to blow yourself with the blow attack

- An error that would cause a delay in walls re-spawning due to explosions of an opponent hitting one of Deborah Fires burning bricks has been fixed

- An error that would cause Vast's balls to be able to be immediately deflected and controlled by his opponent has been fixed and now works as intended.  Vast's split balls will now remain his color for a minimum of ten seconds before they can be changed to his opponents color and control

- Deborah Fire can no longer get stuck in the upper right wall when hit by a blow attack at the exact wrong time and position

- Toxik Karess's poison balls can now properly poison his opponent when they are hit in the body from behind

- Hitting your own protected center ball while it has its protective barrier with your body instead of your paddle show now always immediately free it as a neutral blue ball before your minute control timer is up

- Vast Shadows should no longer see his paddle momentarily disappear when splitting a ball in the face of his opponent

There's probably some minor adjustments and enhancements I made to the game that I am forgetting for this update, but that's the biggest improvements and fixes made in this update.  

As usual, I expect fixing some of these problems and changes I made to break or cause other problems or things that need to be re-balanced.  

Stay safe and do the best you can to play your part at helping everyone slow the spread of the C word out there!  Thanks for reading and/or playing my game if you do!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.87 - Brick Layout Changed
notes.content:
Update 0.87 really just involves my deciding to change the layout of the bricks in the room to provide the balls with proper room to reflect between the walls of bricks.  (The spacing between the walls used to be just 16 pixels and now has been changed to 48 pixels)  The number of bricks in each green wall has also been reduced by one layer and each green wall now has 9 less bricks than before to provide room for this extra spacing between the walls.

That's it for this update.  Have fun out there!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.86 - Fixes and Adjustments To Vast Shadows
notes.content:
This update primarily focuses on the last DLC character "Vast Shadows"..

It should be easier than ever now to split your balls in the face of your opponent while playing Vast Shadows.  Here are the changes made in this update:

- The keyboard controls to split your ball at the appropriate opportunity to split your balls into three additional balls have been changed to:

SPACE BAR  if you control Vast as player 1 on the left side of the screen

RIGHT SHIFT  key if you control Vast as player 2 on the right side of the screen

Using a controller, the button remains the controller X button to split your balls.


- The window of opportunity to split your balls has been made bigger and easier than before.  Remember, once you turn a ball your color and it is moving towards your opponent and on his/her side of the screen, you'll get a "Balls Out!" visual and aural indicator.  Press your active ability button (described above) within about 1.5 seconds and you'll succeed in splitting your balls in your opponents face!

NOTE:  You will only get a "Balls Out!" opportunity if your ball is your color and headed at at least a 45 degree angle or less towards your opponent and you have no existing Vast balls on the screen at the time.

- Your opponent can change your Vast balls to their color just by deflecting it with their paddle but changes have been made in that Vast balls changed to your opponents color will now score points for your opponent when these balls destroy green or blue bricks.  If your Vast ball has been changed to your opponents color and it hits an interior pink brick, both the pink brick and your Vast ball will be destroyed and you'll get a search light shining on you making your vision difficult for a few seconds.

IN THIS UPDATE.. The frozen in ice times for ALL characters has been adjusted to be slightly shorter frozen times.  These frozen times occur when you a character has been "blown" by their opponent.

..That's all the changes that have been made in this update.  Stay safe out there!

notes.title: Update 0.80 - DLC Playable Character "Toxik Karess" is Live!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/e9a2fe3ea31b8ba4b286567b18022cc1dce08a8d.png

Toxik Karess took me about a week longer than I had hoped to finish up with my full time job and life and all... but he is now here and ready for you to purchase and play!

Toxik uses his poisonous paddle to poison the balls his paddle reflects.  

When a poison ball hits any body part of an opponent, they get poisoned which fades slowly over time.

A player poisoned shows as a green poison gas cloud over their character.  This gas cloud will fade over time, but while poisoned, a characters movement speed is drastically reduced, giving Toxik Karess a big advantage and opportunity to score more points!

If a Toxik's own poisoned ball hits his body, it will NOT poison him, unless the poisoned ball his body touched is from his opponent who happens to also be Toxik Karess.  ie.. If both players are Toxic Karess, their balls will poison each other, but their own balls won't poison them if touched.

I hope you all enjoy the new DLC for Toxik Karess!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.72 - Optional Score Difference Indicators Added + Demo Mode To Watch For Hours!
notes.content:
In this update, about every 20 seconds in your games, each player will now see a score difference fade and and fade out directly above their head to help show players where you stand in the match without needed to compare the scores while trying to keep your focus!  This score difference will show up in green if you are winning and be displayed in red if you are behind. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/ac2106c34da48cede864259a47a91215bdad7789.png

This option can be turned off and on in the Settings and the game will save your setting on this option to your local computer so it will remember it the next time you launch the game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/0e9a2faa407ab9b716ba91b38ed43e24013d8b6d.png

Instructions on how to play including the controls used on both keyboard and controller have been changed to now show on a window pop-up when you click the "How To Play" button at the top of the game options.

-----------------------------------------------------------------


Another feature added as a DEMO mode that allows you to walk away or enjoy Prison Ball: Full Blown as a sort of screen saver (should anyone ever want to).  When Demo mode is activated, the computer will select CPU vs CPU, it will choose two random characters and it will select how long it wants to play all by itself and then it will play.  Once the game is over, the computer will wait 15 seconds, and restart a new game with new choices for characters and time.  It will keep playing until you quit the game or turn off the demo mode.

To turn the demo mode on, Press F11 from the main welcome screen.  
To turn the demo mode off, press F12 from the main welcome screen.


Enjoy!

notes.title: GAME IS LIVE! Update to Version 0.69 For Launch! WhooHooo!
notes.content:
" 'Tis better to give than to receive!"

That's the slogan for Prison Ball: Full Blown.. and it's also some very wise words!  ..Ahh hell, who cares about wise words when we can be getting down with some classic retro PONG and Break-Out game action where you can literally blow each other!  

There's some more changes listed below in this update to version 0.69, but I want to remind you all that if you like this game, please let all your friends and social media know about it!  There's good reason for it because remember that the first DLC, now set to hit sometime in August is the DLC playable character named Deborah Fire!  Deborah is one hot head for sure, with blazing red hair and a paddle of fire!  She is sure to ignite the gameplay, set a few opponents balls on fire and also create some dramatic explosions in the field of bricks!  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/cf564d6bee05f24ef56e7de1cc52e2b45cc69f6b.png

The Deborah Fire DLC is set to have a Steam price of $1.99 USD when she launches soon, but if Prison Ball: Full Blown sells 199 units within the first month after today's launch, she will be FREE DLC FOREVER.. FOR EVERYONE!

Okay, patch notes... Here we go:

- Added the ability to select a background with a controller

- Added a new countdown timer from 5 to "GO!" to start each game allowing players to prepare themselves before the action starts

- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to do a blow attack if you were playing against the CPU and chose the player 2 side to play

- Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented colored balls from destroying bricks properly

- Fixed an issue that could cause the CPU to stand still and no longer play if you shot a blow attack at him/her and missed


I know and expect there to be bugs and little issues.  PLEASE let me know about the, because the sooner I know about them, the sooner I can fix them!  The forums here in the bug reports thread is the best place to leave those posts.  I've also created a thread to post game ideas and suggestions if you have an idea you feel will help me make this game more fun!

Have fun everyone and please have a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.60 - Pre Launch Thanks To My Supporters & More Positive Changes!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/8408b70af1b43c50e0b7752af3817ae7d78bbe2f.png

I want to personally thank all my best testers who have played my game and given me vital feedback to help me fix issues and make Prison Ball a better product in time for launch coming just hours away now!  Specific names such as Mellow Online and his group of hardcore Sentinels of the Store indie reviewers, Rusty Foxes on Youtube, and my own personal moderators for my own Youtube channel all had a huge impact on the game as it saw its final weeks in development.  

My moderators such as the amazing FairyGirlz, Laurent Phillies, Jimmatron, Rock and Roll, and even the lovely singer Brookie Bear with her magnificent singing cannot be thanked enough for their ongoing support and belief in me.  There is many more supporters and fans but naming everyone would likely be a losing effort as I'd be bound to forget someone, so I'll just say "A huge thanks to all my fans, subscribers, and believers!"  =)

I'm proud to say that after many hours of work, I am confident that Prison Ball: Full Blown is ready to deliver fun, laughs, and some really close games that might very well be won with a final blow jo.. err I mean a final "blow attack"!

Here are just a few of the changes I've made in this update:

- The balls now bounce and reflect off of bricks better than ever!  While they still make some very unpredictable bounces especially when trapped by bricks, I can honestly say that this has been my toughest challenge as a developer to this point!  Bouncing balls just aren't easy to program in a game like this especially with over 200 bricks on each screen that can produce nearly infinite patterns, caverns and tunnels as the breakdown happens.  I am proud of how far I've come with Prison Ball with this aspect, and while not entirely perfect yet, I know it will continue to get better (much as everyone of my other games on Steam has improved since launch)

- Angela's voices have now been completely changed to give an authentic and real woman's sounds of pleasure, laughter, insults, and pain.

- Many visuals have been added or completely reworked just in time for launch such as the new brick shattering effect, a new explosion of the box that holds the 3rd ball once the box is broken, and  more!

- Stun times from getting hit with a blow attack now vary based on who gets hit and by whom is the blower.  Learning who is weak and strong who who's blow attack should be part of the fun!

- The characters names now appear at the top of the game screen to help show who is who.

I look forward to seeing and reading about how these games go for Steam users!  While it can be played against the CPU, remember that to really have a blast.. you'll want to find someone close to you to challenge them to a local match on your computer!

Launch is almost here!  It's been a journey as this game started development last October!  And while it got put on a shelf for a while to deal with real life, I'm happy to say that Prison Ball is my second biggest project ever (only falling to my pride and joy Rock 'N Roll also available here on Steam!)

Please remember to get the word out about my game if you are interested in it.  I am a very small indie developer who quickly sees my games and effort swallowed in the vast ocean that is Steam.  I would very much appreciate your support not only by playing my games, but also by letting others know about them!  If you are a content creator who streams or makes videos, please comment down below and leave your link to any streams or videos you produce for this game (or for any of my games)!  ...That would be amazing!

Thanks everyone, and watch out for people with big paddles who just want to get on their knees and send hot blown air your way!  I guess this game is just more proof that is really is "better to give than to receive"!   ;-)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.55 - Lots of Changes.. More to Come!
notes.content:
In this update, the first of a few planned before launch, I have made some notable changes:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/17e4177cbf29b77baac932bc4d6855cfa57eebcd.png

- The previous welcome screen has been overhauled as seen above

- An issue has been fixed to prevent pressing the full screen of/on button too quickly which could lock the game up on some computers

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/f68cb297cacc9a62a4cf5e803153cfd818593502.png

- As seen in the image above, each player now starts with a single ball on their own side of the screen and the 3rd ball now starts in a box in the middle that needs to be broken be either a white or black ball to be freed.  The first side to break the box gets full control of the 3rd ball for a minimum of 30 seconds.  This ball is not able to be changed in color until the protective capsule around it fades (30 seconds after it is freed by one side or the other)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35273872/9fc164cd4d2f2a06b61373b85facb80dac8c9e5d.png

- An all new easy "click your choice" background screen is available as an option from the main welcome screen.  Simply click the picture of the background you'd like to play on or choose "Random" to have the game randomize it for you!  (This was previously an option where you had to hit F1 and type in the number or the name of the desired background)

- A sound effects slider has been added to the audio settings to control the audio level of the game SDFX.

- All the previous high pitched brick breaking sound effects have been completely replaced with new deeper rock crunch types of impact sound effects

- When one player controls two or three balls, the other player builds up his blow meter faster to allow him/her a quicker opportunity to strike and get back in the game

- The blow meters now have lightning effects around the bar when the meter is full to help visually inform players they are able to launch a blow attack

- The bouncing of balls off of bricks has been reworked but is not complete yet,  It is better than before and the balls no longer phase through bricks as they did sometimes previously

- Basic goal of the game and controls have been added to the main welcome screen

..More changes are in store before the game launches!  Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.50 - Double the Pleasure, Double the Points & More!
notes.content:
Prison Ball: Full Blown is getting updates and balancing before it goes live while it continues to wait for final approval on the build by Steam. 

Here are some of the note worthy changes made in this update:


DOUBLE POINTS FOR DOUBLE PLEASURE:

To my surprise as the developer of this game, both players landing blow attacks and freezing each other at the exact same time seemed to be happening at a much higher occurrence than I would have ever guessed.. so I decided to add a whole new element to this game when this happens...

Now when both players stun each other with blow attacks at the same time, you'll see the words "Full Blown  Double the Pleasure, Double the Points!" float across the screen and both players will start accumulating double the normal points when any ball their color hits a brick.

The double points will remain in effect for each player until they are hit with another blow attack.   

I believe this will increase the drama and strategic aspect of the game quite a bit and feel like it's a great addition to this game!

Other changes in this update:

- Neutral balls that are blue in color that have either blue because the game just started or because they last hit a players body rather than their paddle will no longer always break bricks when they hit them.  There is a small chance that they will still break bricks based on the hit points of the brick (randomly chosen for each brick at the start of the game) but most of the time, the blue neutral balls will just bounce off bricks now.  Remember that any bricks broken by a neutral ball will not score any points for either player.

- The brick breakage points for both players (black and white) are now easier to see.  (points scored when a ball of your color hits any brick)

- Added a "default" button the audio settings to set all the levels back to the game default settings.

- Because the game has three balls, each player is guaranteed to have at least one ball starting near them on their side of the screen.  The third ball is chosen randomly on which side it begins and to help balance the game. Now, whatever player only gets one ball start near them will get around 35% to 45% of their blow attack bar awarded to them to compensate.

- Changed the look and font used on the "game over" window that pops up when the games end.


More changes are bound to come.. stay tuned!
